site.title: AltWorld Comics
site.intro: AltWorld Comics reimagines forgotten public domain legends as dark pulp, horror and retro comic stories for a new generation.

posts.title: Fantomah Issue #0 is now available
posts.excerpt: A Golden Age jungle horror icon returns in a modern dark pulp reimagining.
posts.body: Fantomah returns as the first release from AltWorld Comics. Issue #0 introduces the tone of the line: forgotten legends, dark pulp atmosphere, supernatural horror and vintage comic DNA rebuilt for a new generation.

posts.title: From 1940 to 2026
posts.excerpt: The old pulp energy survives — rebuilt with a darker, cinematic comic language.
posts.body: AltWorld Comics is built around the idea of rediscovering public domain legends and giving them a modern visual identity. Fantomah is only the beginning.

about.title: About AltWorld Comics
about.body: AltWorld Comics is a dark pulp comic label focused on reimagining forgotten public domain legends, horror icons and retro comic worlds. Our stories blend vintage comic DNA with modern cinematic visuals, supernatural atmosphere and indie publisher energy.
